faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
faq.a1: Yes. Every course includes a verifiable certificate of completion you can share on LinkedIn or with employers.
faq.q2: Can I learn at my own pace?
faq.a2: Absolutely. All courses offer lifetime access, so you can start, pause and resume whenever it suits your schedule.
faq.q3: How do I enroll in a course?
faq.a3: Browse our catalog, pick a course, and click Enroll. Free courses are instantly accessible; paid courses go through a secure checkout.
faq.a4: We accept major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and various regional payment methods depending on your location.
faq.a5: Yes! Apply through the 'Become an Instructor' page. Our team reviews applications and helps you get your first course live.
